## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, with no unrelated formatting or refactoring.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated, or the reason they are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] User-visible copy is available in English and Russian, if applicable.
- [ ] Manual planning, the local library and GPX remain independent of online providers.
- [ ] Saved geometry, GPX segments and existing local data remain compatible, or migration is documented.
- [ ] Directly related documentation was updated, if needed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private route coordinates or personal data are included in code, logs or screenshots.
